==Problem==
Four friends do yardwork for their neighbors over the weekend, earning <imath>\$15, \$20, \$25,</imath> and <imath>\$40,</imath> respectively. They decide to split their earnings equally among themselves. In total, how much will the friend who earned <imath>\$40</imath> give to the others?

<imath>\textbf{(A) }\$5 \qquad \textbf{(B) }\$10 \qquad \textbf{(C) }\$15 \qquad \textbf{(D) }\$20 \qquad \textbf{(E) }\$25</imath>

==Solution==
The friends earn <imath>\$\left(15+20+25+40\right)=\$100</imath> in total. Since they decided to split their earnings equally, it follows that each person will get <imath>\$\left(\frac{100}{4}\right)=\$25</imath>. Since the friend who earned <imath>\$40</imath> will need to leave with <imath>\$25</imath>, he will have to give <imath>\$\left(40-25\right)=\boxed{\textbf{(C) }\$15}</imath> to the others.

==Solution 2==
The friends earn <imath>\$\left(15+20+25+40\right)=\$100</imath> in total. Since they decided to split their earnings equally, it follows that each person will get <imath>\$\left(\frac{100}{4}\right)=\$25</imath>. The friend who earned <imath>25</imath> will not distribute anything, the friend that earned <imath>15</imath> needs <imath>10</imath>, and the friend that earned <imath>20</imath> needs <imath>5</imath>. <imath>10 + 5 = 15</imath>, therefore the answer is <imath>\$\left(40-25\right)=\boxed{\textbf{(C) }\$15}</imath>.
